rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for creative inspiration or a sudden clever idea.

example.english: I suddenly got inspiration just now.
example.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 dat6 jin4 jau5 ling4 gam2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the person, object, or situation that provides the inspiration.

example.english: This painter is the inspiration for my paintings.
example.traditional: 呢位畫家係我畫畫嘅靈感來源。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 waa2 gaa1 hai6 ngo5 waa2 waa2 ge3 ling4 gam2 loi4 jyun4
